user.title: Qualvision / Quvii cloud account
user.description: Sign in with the e-mail and password of your door station's phone app (Balter EVO, Quvii, Homaxi, ...), not the local device password. The account is only used to fetch the station's access secrets; video and door control run locally.

device.title: Door station
device.description: Choose the door station and enter its address on your local network. The station must be reachable from Home Assistant on TCP port 34567. Give it a DHCP reservation in your router so the address does not change.

data_description.device: Door stations found in your cloud account.
data_description.host: Local IP address or host name of the door station.

reconfigure.title: Change door station address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new local address of the door station.

data_description.host: Local IP address or host name of the door station.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Quvii cloud rejected the stored credentials for {email}. Please enter the password again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Quvii cloud server
error.cannot_connect_lan: Could not reach the door station on your local network (TCP port 34567)

abort.no_devices: No door stations were found in this account
abort.reconfigure_successful: The door station address was updated
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Those credentials belong to a different account than the configured one

data_description.door_pin: Leave empty to use the unlock code the door station has registered in the cloud. Only set this if you deliberately want to send a different PIN. The station refuses a wrong PIN and the lock reports it.
data_description.warm_idle: How long the connection to the door station stays open after a command. While it is open the station turns every other client away, the phone app included, so the default is 0: the station is released the moment a command is done.
data_description.stream_duration: Every live view ends by itself after this time, so the station is free again for the phone app and the indoor monitor.
data_description.snapshot_ttl: The camera shows a stored still, the last frame of the latest live view, and does not contact the station for it. Set a time here to have a fresh still fetched once the stored one is older while a dashboard shows it. 0 = never.
data_description.host: Local IP address or host name of the door station.

record_clip.name: Record clip
record_clip.description: Records a short clip from the door station and saves it as MP4.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Target path for the MP4, for example /media/door_station.mp4.

start_live_view.name: Start live view
start_live_view.description: Starts a live view that ends by itself, for example when the doorbell rings. The camera state is "streaming" while it runs and the stored still is fresh afterwards.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Length in seconds. Defaults to the live view length from the options.

end_when_unwatched.name: End when nobody watches
end_when_unwatched.description: Also end the live view a few seconds after the last viewer closed the picture. Use this for a dashboard button; leave it off for a doorbell automation, where the view should run even before anybody has opened it.

stop_live_view.name: Stop live view
stop_live_view.description: Ends the running live view and releases the door station.

refresh_snapshot.name: Refresh still image
refresh_snapshot.description: Fetches a fresh still image from the door station over one short connection.
